name: Be Our Guest Restaurant
description: The most spectacular and sought-after restaurant at Magic Kingdom — Be Our Guest is a magnificent table and counter-service restaurant inside the Beast's enchanted castle featuring three elaborately themed dining rooms including the Grand Ballroom, the Rose Gallery and the West Wing. The most immersive and magical dining experience at any Disney park in Florida. Advance reservations essential.

items.name: Braised Pork
items.description: Slow-braised pork with mashed potatoes and roasted vegetables

items.name: Beef Bourguignon
items.description: Classic French beef stew with crusty baguette

items.name: The Tart
items.description: Lemon meringue tart with French pastry cream

items.name: Grey Stuff
items.description: The legendary grey stuff dessert — it's delicious

name: Cinderella's Royal Table
description: One of the most magical and exclusive dining experiences at Walt Disney World — Cinderella's Royal Table is a princess character dining restaurant inside Cinderella Castle itself, offering extraordinary views from inside the castle turrets and meet-and-greets with Disney princesses. The most coveted character dining reservation in the world. Advance reservations essential.

items.name: Royal Feast Prix Fixe
items.description: Three-course prix fixe with appetiser, entree and dessert including character greetings

items.name: Filet Mignon
items.description: Premium centre-cut filet with truffle butter and seasonal vegetables

items.name: Pan-Seared Salmon
items.description: Atlantic salmon with lemon beurre blanc and asparagus

items.name: Chocolate Slipper
items.description: Signature Cinderella glass slipper chocolate dessert

name: Columbia Harbour House
description: The most atmospheric and highly regarded counter-service restaurant at Magic Kingdom — Columbia Harbour House is a beautifully themed New England seafood restaurant in Liberty Square serving outstanding clam chowder, fish and chips, lobster rolls and seafood dishes. The best quick-service food at Magic Kingdom.

items.name: New England Clam Chowder
items.description: Classic creamy clam chowder in a sourdough bread bowl

items.name: Fish and Chips
items.description: Beer-battered fish with thick chips and tartar sauce

items.name: Lobster Roll
items.description: Fresh lobster in a buttered brioche roll

items.name: Fried Shrimp Basket
items.description: Crispy fried shrimp with fries and coleslaw

name: Pecos Bill Tall Tale Inn and Cafe
description: A classic and beloved Frontierland quick-service restaurant at Magic Kingdom serving generous Tex-Mex dishes including nachos, tacos and burgers in a beautifully themed Western saloon environment. One of the most popular and convenient dining options at Magic Kingdom.

items.name: Nachos Grande
items.description: Loaded nachos with cheese, beans, pico and jalapeños

items.name: Taco Bowl
items.description: Seasoned chicken or beef in a crispy tortilla bowl with rice

items.name: Cheeseburger
items.description: Classic beef burger with cheese, lettuce and tomato

items.name: Frozen Margarita
items.description: Classic frozen margarita

name: Tony's Town Square Restaurant
description: A charming Italian restaurant on Main Street USA at Magic Kingdom themed to Lady and the Tramp — serving classic Italian-American dishes in a beautifully appointed table-service setting that makes a wonderful introduction or finale to a Magic Kingdom day. One of the most romantically themed restaurants in Walt Disney World.

items.name: Spaghetti and Meatballs
items.description: Classic spaghetti with house-made beef and pork meatballs

items.name: Chicken Parmigiana
items.description: Breaded chicken with marinara, mozzarella and pasta

items.name: Tiramisu
items.description: Classic Italian tiramisu with espresso and mascarpone
